channel.title: Mauritius - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mauritius, every source cited.

item.title: Mauritius weighs lowering age for criminal responsibility
item.description: Government considers prosecuting 12-year-olds after recent riots, but experts cite concerns about system capacity and child welfare.

item.title: Mauritius minister defends decision on cancelled exams
item.description: Education Minister Mahend Gungapersad responded to criticism over using assessed marks for SC and HSC exams.

item.title: Mauritius PM meets NGOs after unrest
item.description: Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam initiated dialogue with youth and vulnerable family support groups on October 29.
